components.name: Accent Button
components.description: Primary call-to-action / selected pick button, lit glass in the app's one accent color.
components.css: .ds-btn-accent { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; height: 40px; padding: 0 16px; border-radius: 6px; font-weight: 600; font-size: 14px; color: #000; border: 1px solid rgba(190,158,0,.55); background-image: linear-gradient(to bottom, rgba(255,226,77,.98) 0%, rgba(255,212,0,.94) 55%, rgba(232,190,0,.96) 100%); box-shadow: inset 0 1px 0.5px 0 rgba(255,255,255,.85), inset 0 -1px 0.5px 0 rgba(140,115,0,.25), 0 1px 2px rgba(0,0,0,.18), 0 6px 16px -8px rgba(255,212,0,.75); transition: filter .15s; } .ds-btn-accent:hover { filter: brightness(1.04); } .ds-btn-accent:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px rgba(0,0,0,.6), 0 0 0 4px rgba(255,212,0,.4); }

components.name: Default Button
components.description: Secondary action button, dark chrome glass regardless of theme.
components.css: .ds-btn-default { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; height: 40px; padding: 0 16px; border-radius: 6px; font-weight: 500; font-size: 14px; color: #fff; border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.1); background-image: linear-gradient(to bottom, rgba(20,20,22,.82) 0%, rgba(10,10,12,.72) 100%); box-shadow: inset 0 1px 0.5px 0 rgba(255,255,255,.22), inset 0 -0.5px 0 0 rgba(255,255,255,.08), 0 1px 12px rgba(0,0,0,.3); } .ds-btn-default:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px rgba(255,255,255,.6); }

components.name: Card
components.description: Default content container, flat glass gradient without blur (repeated on every list screen).
components.html:
Fight card
Obsah karty
components.css: .ds-card { border-radius: 12px; border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.5); background-image: linear-gradient(to bottom, rgba(255,255,255,.55) 0%, rgba(255,255,255,.32) 100%); box-shadow: inset 0 1px 0.5px 0 rgba(255,255,255,.85), 0 1px 2px rgba(0,0,0,.08), 0 10px 24px -12px rgba(0,0,0,.3); color: #0a0a0a; } .ds-card-header { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 4px; padding: 16px; } .ds-card-title { font-weight: 600; line-height: 1; } .ds-card-content { padding: 16px; padding-top: 0; }

components.name: Info Badge
components.description: Neutral-but-notable status pill (e.g. 'Uzamčeno' on the events list), distinct from the muted default badge and from the accent/danger tones.

components.name: Input Field
components.description: Text field with the pressed-in glass material (inverted specular).
components.css: .ds-input { display: flex; height: 40px; width: 100%; border-radius: 6px; padding: 8px 12px; font-size: 14px; border: 1px solid rgba(0,0,0,.12); background-image: linear-gradient(to bottom, rgba(255,255,255,.5) 0%, rgba(255,255,255,.78) 100%); box-shadow: inset 0 1px 1.5px 0 rgba(0,0,0,.07), inset 0 -1px 0.5px 0 rgba(255,255,255,.8); } .ds-input:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px #000; }

narrative.overview: The app reads as a piece of arena signage lit from below, not a business tool: a warm yellow glow bleeds up from the bottom of every screen, and nearly every surface — buttons, cards, pills, the nav bar, the bottom bar — is built from the same layered-glass material (.glass-* classes in globals.css): a vertical brightness gradient, a bright specular line along the top inside edge, a hairline rim, and a drop shadow. Structural surfaces (cards, chips, the bottom bar) keep the look of glass without paying for blur; only elements that actually float over content (the header, modals, the install prompt) carry a real backdrop-filter. The system is dark-mode-first, high contrast, and unapologetically loud about its one accent color — yellow — while staying flat and calm everywhere that color isn't the point. Motion is a first-class part of the identity, not a garnish: pages fade and lift in, lists stagger row by row, a saved tip pulses an accent ring, a graded fight's result wipes in left-to-right, and the leaderboard podium rises like blocks growing out of the floor. Every animation is deliberate, short, and wrapped in prefers-reduced-motion / prefers-reduced-transparency fallbacks — motion earns its place by marking a real event, never as decoration for its own sake.
keyCharacteristics: One accent color (#ffd400), used sparingly and always as glass (lit, not flat) so its rare appearances read as chosen or important.
Everything is a layered-glass surface with a consistent light-from-above construction; nothing is a flat, borderless rectangle.
Dark mode is the primary experience; light mode exists but the glow, the chrome header, and event-poster imagery are tuned for dark first.
Motion marks state changes (saved, graded, arrived) — it is never ambient or looping without a reason, and always respects reduced-motion/transparency.

rules.name: The Lit-Not-Flat Rule
rules.body: The accent never appears as a flat #ffd400 fill on an interactive surface — it is always built from the .glass-accent gradient + specular + rim, so the one color the app spends is never spent cheaply.

rules.name: The One Display Rule
rules.body: The condensed Wrapped face is scoped to /wrapped only and never touches body copy anywhere, including on /wrapped itself.

rules.name: The Blur-Where-It's-Earned Rule
rules.body: A component only pays for backdrop-filter if there is real content behind it worth bending; repeated cards and pills use the flat glass gradient instead.

dos: Do build every new interactive/status surface from the existing .glass-* vocabulary rather than a flat Tailwind background.
Do wrap any new looping or entrance animation in a prefers-reduced-motion: reduce fallback, and any new translucent surface in a prefers-reduced-transparency: reduce fallback.
Do reserve backdrop-filter for elements that truly float over visible content; use the no-blur glass classes for repeated/list surfaces.
Do keep motion tied to a real event rather than continuous decoration, except the already-established slow ambient loops.
donts: Don't introduce a generic SaaS dashboard look: no purple→blue gradients, no Inter, no cards-inside-cards, no icon-in-a-rounded-square-above-a-heading pattern.
Don't render the accent color as a flat, unlit fill on an interactive surface.
Don't use the Wrapped display font outside /wrapped, or on body copy anywhere.
Don't add a heavy animation library; motion is hand-written CSS keyframes only.
